# T-1: Add Table list rendering

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add the Table-side behavior needed to render exactly two-column table rows as Markdown bullet list lines.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Two-column `Table` data renders as `- first-column: second-column` lines through a Table-owned method or equivalent class behavior.
- Non-two-column tables fail before list rendering with an error message that references the two-column requirement.
- Existing `Table.toMarkdown()` output remains unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the behavior on `Table` or a Renderable-owned method. Reuse existing cell normalization rules where practical so nullish values and pipe escaping do not diverge without tests.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests in `tests/unit/docs/lib/renderable.test.js` plus spec-local tests for R3, R4, and R5.
